summary.en: Ayumi sees a mysterious man running with a bag. 10 minutes later, an old man named Shousaku Kume says that someone robbed his bag that cointained 300 thousand yen. Location: Beika Town Victim: Shousaku Kume Robbed item: 300.000 yen Later, when the police arrive, a Cheetah Delivery employee asks for help because he found a body in an apartment near the robbery. Location: Koichi Samura's apartment Victim: Koichi Samura Cause of death: Stab wound on the back Suspects: Katsumi Togane The victim, Koichi Samura, was an extorter who blackmailed many people. Later, his friend, Katsumi Togane is found poisoned in an Izakaya at Haido City. Location: Toriko Izakaya, Haido Town Victim: Katsumi Togane Cause of death: Poison It seems that Togane killed himself after robbing Kume and killing Samura. But is this really the case?
